## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle commentary on the *Fànwǎng* bodhisattva-precepts by the Silla-dynasty Korean Buddhist scholar **Ŭijŏk** 義寂 ([義寂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E5%AF%82)). One of the **three principal Korean Silla commentaries** on the *Fànwǎng jīng*, alongside [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo's *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjièběn sījì* ([KR6k0090](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0090)) and [太賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%AA%E8%B3%A2) Tàixián's *Fànwǎngjīng gǔjì jì* ([KR6k0083](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0083)).

**Abstract**

Ŭijŏk's commentary represents the Silla-dynasty **Yogācāra-Cí'ēn 慈恩** reading of the bodhisattva-precepts. Working in the Tang Yogācāra tradition of [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng and [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī, Ŭijŏk reads the *Fànwǎng* precepts within the Yogācāra framework of consciousness-only and the *bodhisattva-bhūmi* progression. The text is one of the principal documents of the Korean Buddhist exegetical tradition's deep engagement with Chinese Buddhist scholarship and is included in the **Taishō** canon as a representative of the East Asian Buddhist commentary tradition on the bodhisattva-precepts.
